svg.font-family: ui-monospace, 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.text: $ tau --help
Usage: tau [options] [command]
AI-powered unified terminal assistant — natural language in, safe commands out.
Options:
-V, --version output the version number
--provider <name> AI provider for this run (mock|ollama|openai|deepseek|zai)
--yes auto-approve low-risk steps (medium needs config allowMediumAutoApprove; never high/blocked)
--json machine-readable output where supported
-h, --help display help for command
Commands:
ask [options] <intent...> Turn a natural-language intent into a reviewed, confirmed execution plan
file Filesystem tools: find, stat, tree, batch rename (dry-run by default)
sys System inspection tools: info, disk, processes (read-only)
net Network diagnostics: port check, ping, fetch, local IP
text Text tools: search, replace (dry-run by default), count
skill Manage Tau skills (SKILL.md plugins)
history Inspect and replay what Tau ran (JSONL store under TAU_HOME)
alias Manage command aliases stored in your Tau config
provider Manage AI providers: API keys, live model discovery and model selection
config View and change Tau configuration (stored under TAU_HOME)
plugin Manage MCP plugins (external tool servers: dsh, VS Code, filesystem, ...)
tui Start an interactive terminal session (REPL)
web [options] Serve the Tau web UI on localhost
help [command] display help for command
